# Create a timer

Stock timer service: one-shot or periodic callback after a number of milliseconds.

**Category:** function · **Address:** `0x6006be97` (runtime cached) · <span class="pill pill-released">Camera-confirmed</span>
{ .facts }

**Build:** [E-M5 Mark III firmware 1.7, build 1700](../firmware/em5-iii-1700.md) · **Cameras:** [Olympus OM-D E-M5 Mark III](../cameras/em5-iii.md)

Arguments: mode, milliseconds, callback, argument. Modes 0 and 128 (periodic) use 12 hardware channels; a null callback is fatal.

## Observations

- **Static analysis** ([Oly Firmware Notes and Mods (E-M5 Mark III)](../projects/em5-iii-notes.md)): Modes, slot pools and limits read from the timer code. Source: [MN103 CPU on the E-M5 III](../sources/em5n.mn103.md).
- **Physical camera** ([Oly Firmware Notes and Mods (E-M5 Mark III)](../projects/em5-iii-notes.md)): A periodic 34 ms timer paced a USB test stream at 21.6 fps. Source: [USB webcam](../sources/em5n.webcam.md).
